convert_script = '''
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF
from fpdf.enums import XPos, YPos

doc = Document("testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

for element in doc.element.body:
    tag = element.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in element.tag else element.tag

    if tag == "p":
        from docx.oxml.ns import qn
        pPr = element.find(qn("w:pPr"))
        style_name = ""
        if pPr is not None:
            pStyle = pPr.find(qn("w:pStyle"))
            if pStyle is not None:
                style_name = pStyle.get(qn("w:val"), "")

        text = ""
        for run in element.findall(".//" + qn("w:t")):
            text += (run.text or "")

        if not text.strip():
            pdf.ln(4)
            continue

        if "Heading" in style_name or "Title" in style_name:
            if "Title" in style_name or "0" in style_name:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 20)
                pdf.cell(0, 12, text.strip(), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align="C")
            elif "1" in style_name:
                pdf.ln(4)
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 16)
                pdf.cell(0, 10, text.strip(), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
            else:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 13)
                pdf.cell(0, 8, text.strip(), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 11)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, text.strip())
        pdf.ln(2)

    elif tag == "tbl":
        from docx.oxml.ns import qn as q
        rows = element.findall(q("w:tr"))
        if not rows:
            continue

        table_data = []
        for row in rows:
            cells = row.findall(q("w:tc"))
            row_texts = []
            for cell in cells:
                cell_text = ""
                for t in cell.findall(".//" + q("w:t")):
                    cell_text += (t.text or "")
                row_texts.append(cell_text.strip())
            table_data.append(row_texts)

        if not table_data:
            continue

        num_cols = max(len(r) for r in table_data)
        col_width = (pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin) / num_cols

        for i, row_data in enumerate(table_data):
            if i == 0:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 11)
            else:
                pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 11)
            for j, cell_text in enumerate(row_data):
                pdf.cell(col_width, 8, cell_text, border=1)
            pdf.ln()
        pdf.ln(4)

pdf.output("testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
print("PDF created successfully from original DOCX")
'''
